cases.name: Atlas Precision Components
cases.trigger: Increase output of turbine components to meet forecast demand
cases.objective: Raise monthly throughput from 1,000 to 1,600 units in six months without loss of quality
cases.evidence: Synthetic site review: cycle-time study, 12-month OTD history and constrained CNC cell
cases.gap: Throughput constrained by CNC utilization and changeovers

finance.gain_basis: Protected orders from capacity increase / avoided delivery disruption

cases.name: Meridian Thermal Systems
cases.trigger: Develop an alternate source for complex heat-exchanger parts
cases.objective: Qualify a new source without a binding business award
cases.evidence: Supplier self-assessment only; no site qualification or yield trial yet
cases.gap: Requires dedicated tooling, qualification and production transfer

finance.mechanism: To evaluate: staged trial or conditional award (not approved)
finance.gain_basis: Option value of qualifying alternate long-lead source

cases.name: Northstar Castings
cases.trigger: Reduce scrap and stabilize output at a complex casting process
cases.objective: Raise first-pass yield from 81% to 93% and protect delivery
cases.evidence: SYNTHETIC: six-month FPY series, scrap Pareto and production engineering audit
cases.gap: Variation at process setup and weak preventive routines

finance.gain_basis: Scrap and rework avoidance plus delivery protection

cases.name: Harbor Controls
cases.trigger: Reduce continuity exposure from single-source control boards
cases.objective: Improve tier-two dependency visibility and recovery preparedness
cases.evidence: SYNTHETIC: dependency mapping workshop and supplier disaster recovery tabletop
cases.gap: Unmapped dependencies and incomplete fallback planning

finance.mechanism: Joint mapping and funded continuity trial

criteria.name: Future demand readiness
criteria.definition: Anticipates changes in volume, product mix and demand.

criteria.name: Capacity confidence
criteria.definition: Demonstrates sufficient and reliable capacity to meet future requirements.

criteria.name: Ramp-up readiness
criteria.definition: Increases production without compromising quality, cost or delivery.

criteria.name: Localization readiness
criteria.definition: Establishes or transfers supply and production capabilities to required regions.

criteria.name: Product and process complexity
criteria.definition: Manages increasingly complex products, technologies and production processes.

criteria.name: Production-system maturity
criteria.definition: Uses a structured, standardized and repeatable production management system.

criteria.name: Operational excellence
criteria.definition: Continuously improves quality, cost, delivery and productivity.

criteria.name: Process stability and yield
criteria.definition: Maintains stable processes while reducing defects, rework and waste.

criteria.name: Flow and constraint management
criteria.definition: Improves material and production flow and resolves bottlenecks.

criteria.name: Throughput and lead time
criteria.definition: Increases sustainable output and reduces end-to-end production time.

criteria.name: Operating routines
criteria.definition: Uses standard work, daily management, reviews and escalation processes.

criteria.name: Capability building and sustainment
criteria.definition: Builds employees' skills and independent ownership of improvements.

criteria.name: Disruption preparedness
criteria.definition: Anticipates disruptions and responds quickly to protect supply.

criteria.name: Dependency visibility
criteria.definition: Identifies critical suppliers, materials, sites and concentration risks.

criteria.name: Volatility management
criteria.definition: Adjusts capacity and supply plans as demand or availability changes.

criteria.name: Structural adaptability
criteria.definition: Sustains supply through tariffs, M&A, downsizing and other structural changes.
